prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 84.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 88.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 84.1%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 35.7%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Helpful changes: Flow reorderings, targeted guidance hints (photo lighting/quality, path decision helper, restore assurance), streamlined layouts (single-click identity, card carousel), hotkey shortcut copy, key desktop flows (summon, visibility/control), and interactive waiting status updates consistently produce significant wins.
Harmful changes: Major flow overhauls (docking setup, split layout), intrusive split view or spotlight layouts, interactive practice flows, and cheat sheet screens consistently lead to performance drops or early test terminations.
No effect seen: Dedicated tutorial or environment prep screens, static waiting hints and carousels, incentive badges, and background completion notifications repeatedly show no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Large positive predictions (+8.0% or higher) consistently overstate actual impact, frequently resulting in no clear effect or severe negative results.
Predictions too low: Major winning changes—especially hotkey shortcut copy, account security/restore hints, and interactive waiting status updates—frequently exceed low or negative initial predictions.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.

            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.

}]}

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Personality Summary Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen layout to a compact style highlighting selected pet traits and name confirmation.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (66.7%) and a high median time (89s). A streamlined card redesign reduces hesitation.

adoption_certificate.headline: Welcome Your New Companion
adoption_certificate.body: Review your companion's traits and confirm their official desktop name.

candidates.title: Story Screen Before Choice Path Shift Flow
candidates.change: Reorder the initial flow so users pick a friend before choosing their journey path.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s, suggesting early path decisions cause hesitation before users establish an emotional connection with a pet.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Placement Readiness Check Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a visual desktop render and overlay status check during the waiting phase.
candidates.why: Support emails show 3 cases where pets failed to display on the desktop or the app stalled on launch.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Overlay
waiting.body: Verifying screen overlay permissions and desktop pet rendering status...

components.text: Pet preparing to launch onto desktop...

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Desktop Visibility Quick Setup Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated quick controls guidance screen right after home intro explaining tray icon and hotkey shortcuts.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails (3) report post-onboarding confusion regarding how to show, hide, or talk to the pet.

new_quick_controls.headline: Desktop Visibility & Controls
new_quick_controls.body: Control your companion anytime using global hotkeys and desktop tray settings.

components.text: Hotkey: Ctrl+Shift+P to summon or hide. Right-click tray icon for full settings.

candidates.title: Multi-Device Account Sign-In Persistence Hint
candidates.change: Add a clear sign-in hint assuring users that logging into the same account preserves existing pets across sessions.
candidates.why: The largest cluster of support emails (8 tickets) relates to missing or reset pets after signing back in.

sign_in.hint: Signing into your registered account ensures all your pets and progress stay synced and restored.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Generation Visual Progress Status
candidates.change: Display real-time dynamic stage indicators and estimated time on the waiting screen during pet creation.
candidates.why: Home waiting stage has a median time of 201s and high drop-off; clearer status feedback keeps users engaged while waiting.

waiting.headline: Crafting Your Custom Companion
waiting.body: Analyzing upload features and generating desktop animation assets...

candidates.title: Clear Photo Subject Guidance Headline Copy
candidates.change: Update the photo upload screen copy to explicitly request well-lit, single-subject photos.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failing or rendering incorrectly due to photo inputs.

upload_photos.headline: Upload a Clear, Single-Subject Photo
upload_photos.body: For best results, upload a clear photo featuring one pet or character in good lighting.
upload_photos.hint: Avoid group shots or heavily shadowed photos for clean pet generation.

candidates.title: Immediate Path Choice Trait Preview Incentive
candidates.change: Add a highlighted feature badge on path choice cards emphasizing exclusive desktop behaviors.
candidates.why: Choose path exhibits long mean duration (514s); highlighting unique rewards accelerates path decisions.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet's Journey
choose_path.body: Each path unlocks unique desktop interactions and exclusive companion traits.

candidates.title: Centered Quick Auth Choice Layout
candidates.change: Switch the sign-in screen to a centered layout focusing on single-click identity options.
candidates.why: Sign-in mean duration is 567s; a clean centered layout reduces visual clutter and speeds up sign-in.

sign_in.headline: Quick Sign-In
sign_in.body: Sign in to safe-keep your pet identity and automatically backup desktop companion data.

candidates.title: Desktop Ready System Notification Opt-In
candidates.change: Enable optional system notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet generation completes.
candidates.why: Mean home wait time is 2336s, indicating users minimize or leave the window while waiting for generation.

waiting.hint: We'll send a system alert as soon as your pet is ready to leap onto your screen.
